description: "Standalone auto-parameterizing synthesis skill. Infers the single interpretive lens (systems / dialectical / archetypal / first-principles / developmental / etc.) that the given input most rewards, declares it in one header line alongside the unit and output type it causally determines, then produces a dense, reflective, transformative synthesis with no fixed word count — length governed entirely by informational-density saturation. Invoke with /synth, 'synth this', or 'synthesize this' followed by or preceding any input. Pure text-in/text-out — no dependency on other skills, no tag-routing, no oracle-core check."
